text_block_list.text:
An unseasonal storm hits on the day of the 
Japanese Derby! At this rate, just as Neo 
Universe predicted, they won't be able to 
reach the racetrack!

Exhausting all options and with the help 
of Chairwoman Akikawa, they somehow manage 
to reach the racetrack. Waiting there for 
them is—

A match against her peer, Zenno Rob Roy. 
Will the two, finally able to stand side 
by side, be able to understand each other 
through the race?
